name: Wells Reserve at Laudholm Day Camps
description_short: Three-day and week-long day camps with hands-on, science-based activities for kids ages 6 to 15. Campers explore field, forest, salt marsh and beach in a protected reserve that has a barn classroom and a teaching laboratory.

sources.note: Drafted by the listing tool from this page

source.title: For Kids & Families – Wells Reserve at Laudholm

warnings: Page is a general overview of kids and family programs (story walks, story hours, Discovery backpacks), not a dedicated camp page.
No upcoming day camps are listed ("There are no upcoming events."). No season year, dates or prices are given, so season_year is left blank.
The camps are both three-day and week-long, so there may not be a standard weekly price.
The $6 fee on the page is for the self-guided Discovery Program backpacks, not the day camps.
